arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Every consecutive Cast of {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} increases the amount of arrows it fires by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c}, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c}. {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} deals {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
